population: U.S. consumer units with exactly three people
status: published national estimate; not a household-specific budget
boarding_school_travel_note: Cannot be estimated from a national spending table without the family's origin and travel frequency. Collect an editable household estimate; null means unknown, not zero.
caveats: The three-person group is not limited to two adults and one child.
Shelter is a published national average across owners and renters, not a three-bedroom rental quote.
The BLS utilities category includes phone charges; HUD utility allowances do not cover telephone service, so the $1,758 phone component remains in the day-school residual.
The residual retains health and vehicle insurance and out-of-pocket healthcare, while the broader personal insurance and pensions category is excluded per model contract.
Boarding-school travel is excluded pending a household-specific input.
